emotional_job: جلب توجه در نیم‌ثانیه — grab before the viewer decides to scroll
recommended_treatment: Put the world on screen already alive: a light pool, drifting motes and one real material, with the hero present but not yet explained
camera: slow inOutSine push 1.00 to 1.04 over 2s; never static
type_role: no type, or one label only
transition: hard cut in with the world already moving
pitfall: An empty stage at t=0 while the world fades up; the first reviewable frame is what gets judged

emotional_job: یک ادعای بزرگ و یک تصویر — one big claim and one image
recommended_treatment: Display line over a designed ground: knock the field darker under the type, place the claim on one line, no deck yet
camera: static, no move in the first 0.6s so the claim reads
transition: cut in with a feathered mask wipe from the right
pitfall: Two live text blocks in one region; or a headline over scenery with no scrim

emotional_job: همدلی با درد — let the viewer recognise the problem
recommended_treatment: Desaturated tint of the film's page, one cluttered frame, lower key light, no accent anywhere in the frame
camera: slight handheld drift from noise(t), <= 0.4 degrees
transition: short dissolve into the problem world
pitfall: Making the problem frame as pretty as the payoff frame, so nothing improves

emotional_job: فشار و بی‌قراری — raise the tension without shouting
recommended_treatment: Tighten the crop, slow the drift to a near-still, add one dark plane in the foreground, pull the signal colour out of the frame entirely
camera: hold the camera nearly still; the stillness is the pressure
pitfall: Cutting to a fully static dead frame, which trips dead-frame detection and reads as a stall

emotional_job: اولین اثبات — the first concrete evidence
recommended_treatment: Material hero shot: the real product treatment with a stated key, a rim, a contact shadow and one environment line
camera: macro push-in 1.00 to 1.14 over 2s outCubic
pitfall: A flat fill standing in for the material, which collapses the proof into a sticker

emotional_job: فهمیدن چطور کار می‌کند — explain the how
recommended_treatment: Three-plane stage: cutaway or cross-section as the subject, environment at lower detail, foreground occluder crossing the frame edge
camera: slow lateral dolly using parallax layers at 0.15-0.35 ratios
transition: cut on the action, no dissolve
pitfall: One flat plane for the whole explanation, so the mechanism reads as a diagram not a place

emotional_job: گام‌به‌گام بودن — show it is a process, not a claim
recommended_treatment: One step per beat, numbered with the numeral role using Persian digits inside a bidi isolate, same stage but new framing per step
camera: camera reframes between steps rather than repeating one framing
pitfall: A numeral set in a Latin display face, or four live roles in one frame

emotional_job: روشن شدن تفاوت — make the difference obvious
recommended_treatment: Two panels of the same world, one graded cooler and one warmer, separated by a 1px gradient rule; same framing family, different value
camera: static, then a lateral move that carries one surviving object across the seam
transition: luma wipe across the seam, <= 14 frames
pitfall: A hard vertical split with no rule and no shared object, which reads as two unrelated frames

emotional_job: دیدن تغییر — let the change be watched, not stated
recommended_treatment: Same camera, same world, one state morphing into the other; keep one continuous object across the change
camera: camera does not move at all; the change must be the only motion
transition: no transition; the change is the transition
pitfall: Cutting between before and after, which makes the viewer compare two different compositions instead of one

emotional_job: اعتبار عددی — credibility through a number
recommended_treatment: Big Persian numeral with the numeral role, a deck line under it, one signal use; the number lands with a spring, not a fade
camera: static; the number's own settle is the motion
pitfall: The counter overshooting past its target, or a numeral in a Latin-family display face

emotional_job: دقت فنی — technical precision
recommended_treatment: A legal/meta block on a designed field with a real grid; Latin and digit runs may carry 0.02em tracking, Persian runs may not
camera: very slow drift only
pitfall: Applying tracking to the Persian copy, which severs the joins

emotional_job: اطمینان بیرونی — borrowed trust
recommended_treatment: Certificate or seal as a real material with a fold and a contact shadow, never as a flat outline; the legal row gets its own value band
camera: static macro on the seal
transition: cut in with a feathered wipe
pitfall: White display type printed across the certificate's own text, the worst defect in the batch

emotional_job: صدای انسانی — a human voice behind the claim
recommended_treatment: Paper-and-ink world with a real quote block on a rule; one pale accent only; Persian line-height >= 1.6
camera: static with a faint ambient drift
transition: dissolve in from the previous world
pitfall: A quote styled as a headline, so nothing distinguishes the voice from the claim

emotional_job: ریشه و اصالت — heritage and authenticity
recommended_treatment: Earth or paper palette, hand-made material treatment, a fold, a fibre, one warm key from a practical in frame
camera: slow pull-back 1.06 to 0.90 over 1.8s
pitfall: A heritage beat shot on the same modern stage as every other beat

emotional_job: غرور فرهنگی — cultural pride
recommended_treatment: Carpet-and-gold or adobe register, Persian numerals used as a graphic device, kashida used once at a legal joint
camera: slow pan right to left along the object
pitfall: Treating Persian numerals as Latin numbers in a different glyph set

emotional_job: نزدیکی — the product lives in a real day
recommended_treatment: Three quick beats, each with its own framing family and background family, one recurring object carried across all three
camera: three different camera relationships: low angle, macro, wide
transition: camera moves between beats, one cut maximum
pitfall: One template with a swapped prop in each beat, the repeated-stage defect

emotional_job: همدلی با تلاش — respect for the work
recommended_treatment: Night palette, one practical as the key, a pool on the floor, motes in the beam, one emissive accent
camera: extremely slow push 1.00 to 1.06 over 3s
pitfall: Grey semi-transparent ellipses standing in for light, which read as lens smudges

emotional_job: آرزو — desire for the object
recommended_treatment: Hero at 25 percent of frame height in 9:16 and 22 percent in 16:9, lit side and shade side, rim toward the key, contact shadow tight to the base
camera: macro push 1.00 to 1.14, or a slow orbit if the world is 3D
pitfall: A hero at 8 percent of frame area in the middle of a dead wall

emotional_job: کشف کردن — the pleasure of discovery
recommended_treatment: Slices or a lid reveal: use canvas2D slice reveal with 6-14 slices and a centre-out stagger so the object is uncovered rather than faded in
camera: static macro; the reveal is the motion
transition: slice reveal as its own beat
pitfall: 60 linear slices, which read as venetian blinds

emotional_job: مهارت — competence in the hands
recommended_treatment: Two planes: a foreground hand or tool crossing the edge and a sharp subject; the tool is scaled with the framing in macro shots
camera: macro with the tool wrapped in its own anchor scale
pitfall: A rig left at world scale beside a magnified part, so it reads as a toy

emotional_job: پوشش و اطمینان — coverage and reassurance
recommended_treatment: Map world: a real plan with consistent light, a route drawn as a growing path with a travelling highlight and a soft trail
camera: slow drift across the map, never a spin
transition: cut in; camera continuity across the route beats
pitfall: A route with no head highlight and no trail, which reads as a hairline

emotional_job: دقت زمانی — precision about time
recommended_treatment: Fixed HUD anchor for the whole film plus a numeral that counts once; the anchor may not move between scenes
camera: static; the HUD is frozen by rule
pitfall: A HUD that migrates across the frame, which is the D3 defect the audit recorded

emotional_job: رفع تردید — answer the doubt before it hardens
recommended_treatment: Strip the frame back to one object and one line; remove the accent so the objection frame is visually quieter than the proof frames
camera: hold the camera still
pitfall: Answering the objection with the busiest frame of the film

emotional_job: ارزش — value, not cheapness
recommended_treatment: Price stack with cards settling from a seeded rotation under 6 degrees so Persian numerals stay legible; one signal use only
camera: static, cards settle into place
pitfall: Cards stacked at random angles with illegible rotated numerals, as in the s11 batch

emotional_job: فوریت — urgency without panic
recommended_treatment: One signal use, one numeral, one deepening of the vignette; urgency is carried by contrast, not by more elements
camera: very slight push 1.00 to 1.03
pitfall: Adding a second signal colour, which cancels the first

emotional_job: اطمینان — remove the last risk
recommended_treatment: Legal or certificate material as a real object with a fold and a contact shadow, on a value band of its own
camera: static macro
pitfall: A decorative band crossing the legal row, which destroys the one line the client must read

emotional_job: پیشرفت — visible progress
recommended_treatment: A row of items where every instance varies in rotation, depth and occlusion from a seeded PRNG; the newest one is the only lit one
camera: slow tracking shot along the row
pitfall: Three identical copies of the hero asset at quarter scale on one soft shadow

emotional_job: انسان‌ها — the people behind it
recommended_treatment: Portraits or roles as cards with a frost treatment, a rim and an inner shadow; equal height and weight on one baseline
camera: slow lateral move at one parallax rate
pitfall: Peer cards at different sizes and baselines, which reads as a mistake

emotional_job: مناسبت — the season or occasion
recommended_treatment: Shift the page tint within 10 percent saturation of the film page; never introduce a new hue family for the occasion
camera: static with a light sweep on the beat
transition: circle reveal anchored on the subject
pitfall: A festive fifth colour world bolted onto the end of the film

emotional_job: تعلق مکانی — belonging to a place
recommended_treatment: One map or skyline form as a designed negative shape, not as a wallpaper grid; name the negative form in the scene table
camera: slow pull-back to reveal the whole place
pitfall: A decorative grid identical in every shot, which stops being space and becomes a watermark

emotional_job: تنفس و جهت — a breath and a signpost
recommended_treatment: Label + headline on a near-empty field, but the empty field must be a named form, never more than 60 percent undifferentiated
camera: static
transition: mask wipe from the right, feathered
pitfall: A chapter card at 95 percent blank paper, which reads as running out of things to draw

emotional_job: سرعت و انبوهی — accumulation
recommended_treatment: Three to five beats, each with a different framing family and entrance direction, one surviving object carried across the cuts; stagger the group at 60-90ms
camera: three different camera relationships inside five seconds
transition: camera moves plus at most one masked wipe
pitfall: One background family and one entrance direction for the whole montage

emotional_job: اجازه‌ی دیدن — permission to look
recommended_treatment: Deliberate stillness for 0.4-1.0s: only the ambient layer drifts, 4px horizontal and 2.5px vertical on the world layer, never on the type
camera: static; the drift is the only motion
pitfall: A hold with zero motion anywhere, which reads as a frozen frame and trips dead-frame detection

emotional_job: جمع‌بندی — collect what was shown
recommended_treatment: Three short returns to earlier framings, each 12-20 frames, matched cuts on the same object so the eye completes the thought
camera: match cuts; no new camera move
pitfall: A recap that introduces a new composition the viewer never saw, which reads as new information

emotional_job: اقدام — the one thing to do next
recommended_treatment: Accent pill with the page colour as its label, a small outBack settle, and enough clear space around it that it is unambiguously the only ask
camera: static
pitfall: Two competing CTAs, or an accent pill whose label fails 4.5:1

emotional_job: نشانه‌گذاری — the brand takes the frame
recommended_treatment: Lockup in a designed field: a stroked hexagon mark, headline, subtitle, one signal colour, partner row on one baseline
camera: static; a 6 percent scale settle at most
transition: cut in, or a circle reveal anchored on the mark
pitfall: A logo pasted flat onto busy scenery with no field around it

emotional_job: ماندن در ذهن — the frame they screenshot
recommended_treatment: Own grid, own hierarchy, own safe area; three roles maximum; text-on-text free; inside the film's page hue family; clean at 100 percent
camera: static; at most a 3 percent settle
transition: cut in from the last beat
pitfall: A fifth colour world, a ribbon and seal floating over the border, and a headline across the card's own text

emotional_job: احترام — respect and closure
recommended_treatment: Legal role on a quiet field, 55 percent alpha, Latin tracking allowed, held for at least 1.2s so it can be read
camera: static
pitfall: Credits over the end-card lockup, so two text blocks share a region

emotional_job: جهت‌دهی — tell the viewer the world is changing
recommended_treatment: A shader transition that straddles one cut for at most 14 frames, both layers rendered by the same pure scene painter
camera: camera continuous across the transition
transition: shader transition straddling one cut, <= 14 frames
pitfall: A sustained CrossZoom or LinearBlur, measured at about 4fps at 1080p, used as a whole shot

emotional_job: رسیدن — the promise lands
recommended_treatment: Every system peaks in one frame: type at display scale, the light pool at its widest, the accent at its only large use, the vignette at its deepest
camera: slow push that stops exactly on the payoff frame
transition: cut on the beat, no dissolve
pitfall: Two frames claiming the peak, so neither lands and the film has no climax

emotional_job: اطلاعات زیاد — many numbers, one reading order
recommended_treatment: Three numerals maximum per frame, one label, ghost copy reserving each cell's width; a divider line carries the grouping instead of a fourth role
camera: static
pitfall: Four live roles in one frame; the numeral counts as one of the three

emotional_job: لمس جزئیات — texture and care
recommended_treatment: Extreme macro on one surface with the material kit's treatment scaled to the host, plus a 0.5-2px chromatic aberration and grain
camera: macro push 1.00 to 1.14 over 2s with a local clock
pitfall: Emissive detail at a fixed radius on a macro part, which reads as an orange ring

emotional_job: زنده بودن — the film is breathing, not frozen
recommended_treatment: Atmosphere in front of and behind the subject: 20-40 motes from a seeded PRNG, a bokeh field of at most 30 sprites, and a noise drift on the world
camera: static camera; all motion is ambient
pitfall: Atmosphere only behind the subject, so nothing ever passes the lens

emotional_job: تنوع بصری — break the template without losing the world
recommended_treatment: A new background family and a new entrance direction, but the same page hue and the same white token
camera: a camera relationship the film has not used yet
pitfall: A new world rather than a new composition, which reads as another film

emotional_job: وزن سکوت — let a beat land without copy
recommended_treatment: No type at all for 0.6-1.2s, only the world and one moving object; the absence of copy is the emphasis
camera: static or a very slow pull-back
transition: cut in from a copy-heavy beat
pitfall: A silent beat that is also a still beat, which reads as a dropped frame
